original_test_intent: Stage approved Gen4 PCIe-switch firmware, activate it by controlled AC cycle, and prove the switch plus every connected upstream/downstream path and device returns at the correct state.
original_method: Identify switch serial/inventory and full fan-out; baseline active version, routes, link width/speed and errors; validate signed image, dependencies and recovery; upload once to mapped Redfish target and follow returned task; operator AC-cycles; re-read active firmware and compare every link/device, BMC and host health.
manual_activity: Board owner maps the Gen4 switch and approves payload/recovery; operator controls flash window and AC cycle; agent may only perform the authorized Redfish/task/readback steps.
required_inputs: Switch serial/inventory ID and complete upstream/downstream topology
Signed image/hash, current/target active version, dependency and compatibility manifest
Rollback/redundant image or vendor recovery procedure
Exact BMC Redfish target, credential/certificate and task semantics
Job drain, stable power, console/PDU and explicit flash/AC approvals
safety_requirements: Never treat HGX_0 as proof of switch identity
Reject incompatible/unsigned bundle or incomplete topology
Do not clear existing logs or assume task ID 1
No AC action until staging terminal state and operator authorization
Stop on lost/degraded path, AER growth, boot or BMC failure; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Capture immutable baseline and perform one approved upload
Follow returned task and collect post-AC active version/fan-out evidence
engineer_actions: Resolve HGX target-to-switch mapping and approve image/oracles
Authorize service interruption and own recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic nvflash/nvsm omits the Redfish UpdateService path, switch identity and dependent PCIe fan-out.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Upload the signed switch image only to its mapped authenticated Redfish target, monitor the returned task URI, then after approved AC activation query active version and every upstream/downstream link/device/error counter.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Gen4, HGX_0 and thirty minutes remain source facts; the physical switch and safe timeout are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a topology snapshot keyed by switch serial/port that joins image/task evidence to post-cycle routing, negotiated links and device inventory.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the switch's complete blast radius observable rather than checking one version string.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A correct switch version does not prove fan-out health if a GPU/NVSwitch path is absent or downgraded.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A failed switch may block host boot and all in-band evidence; independent BMC/PDU/console recovery is mandatory.

project_override_considerations: Platform owner supplies switch SKU/port map, supported payload and exact per-link speed/width/device/error acceptance.
expected_evidence: Signed payload/hash and pre/post active switch version
Sanitized Redfish target/upload plus returned task states/messages
Operator AC event and BMC/console/host recovery timestamps
Every upstream/downstream device, speed/width and AER/log delta

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row266 Wistron-NV GPU-00259-V002: identify the Gen4 PCIe switch serial/inventory and complete fan-out behind HGX_0; approve signed image, active versions, per-port device/link/error oracle, Redfish task/activation semantics, rollback and AC-cycle/OOB recovery.

review_improvement: Extends firmware version checking to every dependent path and makes switch identity, activation and recovery auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: A PCIe switch firmware defect can alter routing or training on one port while the switch itself still reports the new version. Because a single switch may fan out to several accelerators, acceptance needs port-level device and link comparison plus error deltas. Cold activation is distinct from staging, and a bad image may prevent the OS from booting, so the OOB path is part of the test design.
